blocks.text: Jesus first directs the Twelve to Israel in verses 5–6. Matthew places this limited mission beside a later commission directed to all nations, creating a question about how these two instructions relate within the Gospel’s larger presentation of Jesus’ mission.

The language of household division in verses 35–36 is often understood as an echo of Micah. This is one instance in which New Testament writers are seen to reuse or echo Micah in settings involving Bethlehem, shepherds, household conflict, and Davidic expectation.
